title: dbt Semantic Layer and MetricFlow Documentation

sources.notes: Official dbt Semantic Layer overview for centralized metric definitions, MetricFlow-powered SQL generation, downstream integrations, access-control posture, tiers, setup, deployment, caching, and consumption.
Official MetricFlow concepts page for YAML abstractions, semantic graph, semantic models, metrics, SQL query construction, dbt/dbt Core usage, and MetricFlow Apache 2.0 license pointer.
Official semantic models page for YAML abstractions over dbt models, joining keys as graph edges, metadata, defaults, entities, dimensions, and measures.
Official entities page for primary, unique, foreign, and natural entity types as join keys across semantic models.
Official dimensions page for categorical/time dimensions, expressions, partition windows, time granularity, and SCD Type II validity windows.
Official measures page for aggregations over model columns, measure names, expressions, aggregation time dimensions, non-additive dimensions, and percentile behavior.
Official metrics overview for simple, cumulative, derived, ratio, and conversion metrics plus metric filters over entities, dimensions, time dimensions, and metrics.
Official join-logic page for entity graph joins, left/full outer join strategies, fan-out/chasm avoidance, multi-hop joins, and semantic validation through explain queries.
Official saved-queries page for reusable MetricFlow query definitions, metrics/dimensions/filters, DAG visibility, caching, and export configuration.
Official exports page for materializing saved queries as tables or views in a data platform for tools without first-class Semantic Layer integrations.
Official architecture page for Semantic Layer components, SQL generation, data-platform query routing, supported interfaces, and diagrams/media boundaries.

MetricFlow repository README/source identity under Apache 2.0; describes semantic-layer metric definitions compiling into reusable SQL via dataflow-based query plans, optimizer, engine-specific rendering, multi-hop joins, complex metric types, and time-grain aggregation.
